body:
Founder terse ask ('add cows'), interpreted in context as WC3-style harmless critters. Real creep_spawn_cow built on the existing creep aggro/chase/leash/reset system: low hp, neutral faction, new passive flag that makes a creep wander (deterministic step pattern, no PRNG) instead of scanning for aggro, bounded to a real radius from home. Cows never fight back but aren't immune to being killed by real faction creeps (falls out of the existing faction-inequality aggro rule for free). New LIVING_MAP_EVENT_CREEP_WANDERED event. 21 new tests, full Living Map suite green (132 assertions). ECOWAR commit b62ac34.

⚓ ☃
title: Add cows: passive, wandering neutral Living Map wildlife
